newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Sungei Way proposes bonus, rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Sungei Way proposes bonus, rights issue.

text.p: Sungei Way Holdings Bhd said on Tuesday that it was proposing a bonus issue, a rights issue and a Euroconvertible bond issue.

The company said In a statement that it plans a one-for-one bonus issue of 205.93 million new ordinary shares, a one-for-four rights issue of up to 51.48 million new ordinary shares, and a Euroconvertible, five-year bond issue of between $100 million and $110 million.

The Euroconvertible bond, which is a bond convertible into stock, will be listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange, Sungei Way said. The new shares to be issued on conversion of the Euroconvertible bond will be listed on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
The proposed rights issue is expected to raise gross proceeds of about 176.4 million ringgit, while the proposed Euroconvertible bond will raise gross proceeds of about 250 million ringgit.

Proceeds from the proposed rights issue will be used for capital investments, repayment of borrowings and other expenditures. The proposed Euroconvertible bond issue will be used to finance offshore investments and a local road project.
